### Checklist
Please complete the checklist by placing an 'x' inside each checkbox.

- [ ] I am using the latest Obsidian version
- [ ] I am using the latest Obsidian installer version (to update, download and reinstall Obsidian)
- [ ] I am using the latest Iridium version
- [ ] I am not using the early access version
- [ ] The bug is not present in the default theme

### Describe the bug. Provide screenshots if applicable.
